blocks.raw: An origin server is a physical location that houses your deliverable content. This accounts for the second stage of the [request flow](https://techdocs.akamai.com/adaptive-media-delivery/docs/understand-the-request-flow)—the request from edge servers to your origin to get your deliverable content. Before you can add your origin server to your request flow, you need to set some things up for your origin, collect key information about your origin, and decide how you want ​​Akamai​ to interact with it.
